basic_info.description:
Beautiful 2 bedroom flat in the heart of the Marina. The unit has classic details: tall ceilings, hardwood floors, fireplace, period moldings,spacious south facing living rooms with French doors to balcony, formal dining room, dishwasher, and in-unit laundry. Showings by appointment Saturday June 29th between 10:30am and 1pm and Sunday June 30th between 3pm and 5pm. July 1st or July 15th move-in. If you choose to apply for the unit household member over the age of 18 must provide: 2 forms of ID A credit report run within the last month
3 months of paystubs (that is 12 paystub if paid weekly and 3 if paid monthly)
3 months of bank statements Landlord references and rental history for last three years Please note that your monthly income should be three times the monthly rent ($14,700). Move-in will require first and last month's rent plus a deposit which totals to $14,700 provided by bank check. All households are required to obtain renter's insurance with in one month of move-in.

Owner pays all utilities except electricity
